report:
Fresh source assessment of the current complete resolved_symbols claim, all five implementation entries, and all eleven tests after start with the current coordinator instructions. Every entry is ordinary; no TODO or N/A evidence is being treated as implemented. No source changes were necessary in this refresh.

Implementation: annotations.rs recognizes bare sym and calculates the selected source line. source.rs enumerates only explicit expression CST nodes, tagging paths and traversing receivers/arguments without treating field names, method names, type syntax, or patterns as paths. observe.rs calls completed function.body, freezes typed-path resolution using symbols.rs, matches source expressions to semantic nodes by span and kind, filters by start line and path kind, and errors for invalid/missing correspondence or a line with no path. Implicit elaboration nodes do not independently enter the source-driven output inventory. Symbols.rs uses PathResolution definitions rather than token spellings; local module items receive a kind and crate-qualified module/name, variants include their enum, external symbols use tcx.def_path, and bindings count only preceding same-named declarations plus one. Missing bindings and ambiguous tied identities error. Local associated function/constant identities are excluded by owner guards and produce unsupported errors. Actual PathResolution errors and checked error nodes are represented as <unresolved>, while unresolved/missing typed correspondence is invalid. Types.rs supplies qualified_local_name; its ancestry walk ensures nested module names appear in order. Names become owned strings within check_crate/walk_expr, before collect takes the inspection log; rendering operates on frozen values. The captured CompileTest macro/run/prepare code confirms observation expectations assert actual prepared output and cannot steer resolution.

Test mapping: aliases_and_qualified_paths_identify_the_definition asserts two distinct crate-qualified fn identities despite equal item names and an import alias, testing actual definition selection and selected source lines. shadowed_locals_have_distinct_stable_identities asserts value#1 before shadowing and value#2 afterward with unrelated intervening bindings; exact output also excludes allocation IDs and source coordinates. external_definitions_use_metadata_paths asserts the external Ordering variant metadata path. symbols_and_types_share_expression_headers asserts the precise path/call example from the claim, symbol then type, with repeated markers deduplicated. symbol_selections_require_paths_and_expectations asserts missing-expectation and literal-only/no-path errors. unresolved_paths_still_require_error_markers now specifically asserts the Sage diagnostic mismatch, then exact <unresolved> symbol output after accounting for the diagnostic, and separation from diagnostic/query text. This strengthened assertion cannot accidentally pass solely on a rustc mismatch. unsupported_associated_identity_is_not_unresolved constructs a real trait-associated function and asserts the explicit unsupported identity error. missing_local_correspondence_is_not_an_unresolved_name asserts an out-of-range local semantic reference errors instead of producing <unresolved>.

Selection exclusions are covered by symbol_selection_excludes_field_names_types_and_let_patterns, whose inline fixture expects only the receiver path on the selected declaration line, and only_expression_paths_are_symbol_candidates, whose CST traversal assertion lists exactly four value paths while excluding method/field/type/pattern identifiers. The latter is deliberately selector-level evidence, not a claim that checking every syntactic scenario is supported; generated calls cannot enter this CST enumeration. cold_capture_includes_discovery_and_observation_reads_without_changing_bodies asserts the external identity, captured executed tcx::def_path, equal traces with/without selection, and both body executions. Together with the owned-string boundary this covers freezing before query capture ends. These assertions would detect alias-spelling identities, ordinal changes from unrelated locals, extra selector categories, silently empty observations, missing-resolution placeholders, or loss of name reads from capture.

Dependencies captured through review read: CompileTest implementation and macro; with_test_crate/local_function_named and setup helpers. Other implementation helpers used for this judgment are already present in the five whole-file initial fragments. All test assertions and expectations were inspected in full. This is a source review only: I ran the review start/read/record workflow and source inspection commands, not Cargo test or build suites in this refresh. Root runs centralized validation. No requested edits remain.
